_doc: Return denominators per live sleeve. NOT capital allocations: the sleeves share one account's collateral, so these overlap and do not sum to NAV. Change a value ONLY together with a dated row in docs/capital_bases.md (change log), in its own commit, like any config change.

magic-formula.represents: inception NAV: the account's funded size when magic-formula went live (read from its state.json inception_nav; this figure documents it)

trend-overlay.represents: notional sizing budget: BUDGET 50,000 x OVERLAY_MULT 1.5

options-vrp.represents: BUDGET: the risk base that sizes each spread (3% max loss per position)
